name: Image Generator
description: Generates image artifacts through configured cloud or approved local providers. Provider selection is explicit or uses the configured default.
brief: Use the `image-generator` skill only after an administrator enables it and configures an approved provider. The `generate_image` tool accepts an explicit provider or uses the configured default provider.
author: Evonic

variables.name: default_provider
variables.label: Default Provider
variables.description: Provider ID used when generate_image does not specify a provider. It must identify an enabled provider from the provider registry.

variables.name: allowed_providers
variables.label: Allowed Providers
variables.description: Comma-separated provider IDs permitted for this skill. Keep this allowlist limited to reviewed cloud or local providers.

variables.name: allow_local_providers
variables.label: Allow Approved Local Providers
variables.description: When enabled, permits providers declared as local only when they also appear in Allowed Providers.

variables.name: automatic1111_endpoint
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Endpoint
variables.description: Administrator-approved base URL for the local AUTOMATIC1111-compatible API. Agents cannot override it.

variables.name: automatic1111_trusted_hosts
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Trusted Hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated exact endpoint hostnames approved by an administrator. Required when enabling the local provider.

variables.name: automatic1111_timeout_seconds
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout for the local provider, from 1 through 120 seconds.

variables.name: automatic1111_steps
variables.label: AUTOMATIC1111 Default Steps
variables.description: Administrator-controlled fixed generation step count for the local provider, from 1 through 100.

variables.name: comfyui_endpoint
variables.label: ComfyUI Endpoint
variables.description: Base URL for the approved local ComfyUI API.

variables.name: comfyui_workflow_template
variables.label: ComfyUI Workflow Template
variables.description: Name of the administrator-approved workflow template used for image generation.

variables.name: comfyui_timeout_seconds
variables.label: ComfyUI Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout for ComfyUI, from 1 through 300 seconds.

variables.name: comfyui_polling_interval_seconds
variables.label: ComfyUI Polling Interval (seconds)
variables.description: Interval used to check asynchronous ComfyUI jobs, from 1 through 10 seconds.

variables.name: comfyui_api_key
variables.label: ComfyUI API Key
variables.description: Optional credential for ComfyUI deployments that require API authentication.

variables.name: google_gemini_api_key
variables.label: Google Gemini API Key
variables.description: Write-only Google Generative Language API credential used only by the approved Google Gemini provider.

variables.name: google_gemini_model
variables.label: Google Gemini Model
variables.description: Approved Google image-generation model.

variables.name: google_gemini_timeout_seconds
variables.label: Google Gemini Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Bounded request timeout for Google Gemini, from 1 through 120 seconds.

variables.name: max_images_per_request
variables.label: Maximum Images Per Request
variables.description: Upper limit for images requested in a single generation call (1 through 10).

variables.name: requests_per_minute
variables.label: Requests Per Minute Per Agent
variables.description: Per-agent rolling request cap. Set from 1 through 60 for a controlled pilot.

variables.name: max_concurrent_requests
variables.label: Maximum Concurrent Requests Per Agent
variables.description: Per-agent in-flight generation cap (1 through 4).

variables.name: images_per_day
variables.label: Images Per Day Per Agent
variables.description: Per-agent UTC rolling daily image quota. Set to 0 only to disable this skill through quota.

variables.name: mock_enabled
variables.label: Enable Deterministic Mock Provider
variables.description: Development and test only. The mock provider remains unavailable unless this is explicitly enabled.

variables.name: provider_api_key
variables.label: Provider API Key
variables.description: Optional provider credential. It is reserved for future production adapters and is never returned in tool results.

provider_selector.label: Provider
provider_selector.description: Choose the provider you want to configure. Your unsaved values are retained while you switch providers.

providers.label: Google Gemini
providers.description: Cloud image generation through the configured Google Gemini model.

providers.label: AUTOMATIC1111
providers.description: Approved local AUTOMATIC1111-compatible image generation API.

providers.label: ComfyUI
providers.description: Local ComfyUI image generation using an administrator-approved workflow template.

providers.label: Deterministic Mock
providers.description: Development-only provider for predictable test images.

global_section.label: Global Image Generator Defaults
global_section.description: These preferences apply to Image Generator regardless of the provider you are configuring.
